title: Workflow Contract Schema
description: JSON Schema for validating workflow contracts. Workflows are frozen CommittedPlans saved for repeated execution (cron, event trigger, or manual).

name.description: Canonical capability name. Must follow convention: workflow.run.<name>

source_plan_id.description: UUID of the original CommittedPlan this workflow was compiled from

trigger.description: How and when this workflow is triggered

steps.description: Ordered list of execution steps (frozen from CommittedPlan)

dependencies.description: DAG dependency map: step_id -> [dependency_step_ids]. Must be acyclic.

max_depth.description: Maximum workflow nesting depth (prevents infinite recursion)

allows_sub_workflows.description: Whether steps in this workflow may trigger sub-workflows

safety_band_min.description: Minimum safety band required to execute this workflow

avg_latency_ms.description: Average total workflow execution time in milliseconds

active.description: Whether this workflow is currently active and eligible for triggering

run_count.description: Total number of times this workflow has been executed

schedule.description: Cron expression (required when type=cron, e.g. '0 8 * * MON')

timezone.description: IANA timezone for cron schedule (e.g. America/Los_Angeles)

event_topic.description: Event topic that triggers this workflow (required when type=event)

id.description: Step identifier (unique within the workflow, e.g. s1, s2)

prompt_template.description: Prompt template to use for this step (if step invokes an agent)

params.description: Parameters to pass to the capability. Values starting with $ reference other step results (e.g. $s1.result)

tools_granted.description: Tools granted to this step (if agent step)

deps.description: Step IDs this step depends on (must complete before this step runs)
